text:
incident-bot: :warning: Pager: prod-runtime queue latency spike in us-west-2. p95 tokens > 3s for last 4m, errors up ~5% on /v1/embeddings. Paging oncall.

maya: acked — I'm on it, grabbing metrics and pods.

maya: quick snapshot — queue depth up, a couple of model workers at 95% GPU mem, CPU fine. Traffic burst from a handful of customers (acme-inc + beta-team), mostly long-sequence embed requests.

sylvia: noted. Could be KV cache pressure + long tails. Suggest we reduce max_inflight on the embed route first to shed and keep latency SLO.

raj: +1. I'll push a soft-shedding rule and lower max_inflight for /v1/embeddings.

maya: commands I'm going to run (handing to raj to execute if I'm slow):
```bash
# reduce per-route in-flight concurrency
infra-cli route update --name embeddings --max-inflight 16
# enable soft-shedding: evict requests waiting > 10s
infra-cli route update --name embeddings --shedding-threshold 10s --shedding-mode soft
```

raj: executing now.
raj: `infra-cli` output: updated embeddings max_inflight: 32 -> 16, shedding enabled (soft, 10s).

kevin-support: informing customer success and sending heads-up to impacted customers (acme-inc, beta-team). Draft msg: "We're seeing degraded embedding latency; we applied temporary rate/inflight limits and a fallback — you may see transient 429s or slower responses while we stabilize." Want approval to send.

maya: send it. Keep it short. cc: @kevin-support.

sylvia: also enabling model fallback for heavy requests (route-level policy to route to quantized-1 if available) — lowers GPU pressure but slightly lower quality. Command: 
```json
{"route":"embeddings","fallback_model":"distil-embed-quant-v1","fallback_ratio":0.25}
```

raj: fallback enabled, starting at 25% for new requests.

maya: monitoring metrics — queue depth starting to drop, p95 coming down from 3.6s -> 2.1s within 90s. errors trending down.

sylvia: good. Let's also temporarily tighten free-tier token quotas to reduce noise while we finish rollouts:
```bash
quota-cli update --tier free --per-minute 60
```

kevin-support: sent customer note to acme-inc + beta-team. Included mitigation and ETA for follow-up.

maya: paging handoff — I'll be on-call for next 30m to confirm stability, then hand to raj for remediation & postmortem. raj, can you follow up to revert changes or tune more gracefully once load normalizes?

raj: yep. Plan: leave shedding in soft mode for 10m, then scale fallback_ratio up to 50% if latency regresses, or revert max_inflight back to 32 when p95 < 1.2s for 5m. I'll also open a ticket for perf team to investigate KV cache pressure.

sylvia: creating incident stub: incidents/4512345670-embed-latency-ust-west2. Adding runbook tags: runtime-queue, shedding, fallback-model, customer-impact.

maya: notes for post-incident: consider autoscaling policy change (earlier pod spin-up), per-customer burst caps on embeddings, and more aggressive KV caching for long sequences.

kevin-support: customers acknowledged. acme-inc saw a handful of 429s and lower throughput for 7m, but no data loss.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by maya, status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maya: handing off to raj now. staying reachable.

raj: taking over — will run a 30m watch and start the postmortem draft. Thanks. :thumbsup:

sylvia: closing oncall thread for active mitigation; will reopen if metrics regress.

maya: resolved for now. follow-up actions assigned to raj + perf + support.
